sections.text:
This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every 
 2000 operating hours as indicated by H2000 in the title block.

The 
 compressor is required with 3 blow off valves to prevent any surge condition 
 at low speed and to reduce the power required on start-up. The closing of the 
 blow-off valves is controlled by the pressure switch R2585 set to 4.7 bar 
 compressor discharge pressure. This switch opens at its set pressure to 
 deenergize the solenoid valve R1582. The solenoid valve closed their air bleed 
 part and open the supply part to allow control air pressure from the 
 compressor discharge to close the blow off valves. When the turbine trips, low 
 safety oil pressure allows hydraulic valve R2284 to close their supply ports 
 and open their bleed ports thus removing air control from the blow- off 
 valves.

This document revised by eng. Ayman Mohamed Mohamed; tested by eng. Magdi Sami 
 Ebrahim accepted by eng.Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, approved by general manger 
 eng.Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control 
 director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality 
 control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

Wear your safety helmet, 
 shoes... etc.

Unit on the full speed no
